ratings_why.fun: Clear growth shape: small change-payers early, Ring-Dike and Heemraad mid, then Hendrika's full swings late; and a Flood that scales as a share of Health stays relevant all game.
ratings_why.distinct: One visible Level that floods both front rows makes positioning a fresh slot puzzle, though the change-counting engine itself plays like familiar trigger-count tribes.

verdict_why: The core works; two rules questions about Raise and Drain need settling before the swing build can be read.

points.text: Say whether a Drain that can't move the Level still counts. As written, Sluice Keeper at Level 0 may give 1 gold for nothing, and Ditch-Digger and Master of the Nine Mills may fire on empty Drains. Simplest: Raise and Drain payoffs need a change.
Say whether each extra step from Hendrika counts as a Raise or Drain for Ring-Dike, Ditch-Digger and Nine Mills, or only as a change. The swing build's payoff depends on it.
The Spaarndam Pup ends the Afloat and Dike puzzle at the top of the game. 'Your Floods can't harm your units' keeps the mirror and enemy Floods a positioning question.
Winter Raft is a plain End of Turn buffer. Paying per change, or per enemy unit the Flood hurt, would tie it to one of the builds.

standouts.why: Hendrika turns one Drain and one Raise into a full 5-to-0-to-5 swing: a capstone you build toward and feel.
Aaltje lets a board drain for value all turn and still flood in the fight; a smart bridge between builds.
Tail-Slapper makes your own deaths re-flood, so losing units feeds the fight.

weakest.why: Generic buffer for Afloat units, with no link to Level changes.
Afloat for another unit is thin outside the tribe; the +3/+3 fallback carries it.
Random target makes Drain stats hard to aim at your carry.

flags.note: Hendrika plus Kobus Bles plus Nine Mills or Old Bram: about 20 doubled changes a turn, well over 100 stats. Bounded per turn, but far above the Tier 6 target.
Golden Pup floods twice and reaches the back row; with Tail-Slapper at Level 5 an enemy board can lose most of its Health before any attack.
The 'at least 1' floor at Level 1 pops every front-row Shield and kills 1-Health units from turn 1 or 2.
Can you Drain at Level 0 for the gold?
Do Hendrika's extra steps count as Raises or Drains for other cards?
